parent_center.name: Family Resource Center on Disabilities
parent_center.checked: Verified via parentcenterhub.org. Located at 20 E. Jackson Boulevard, Room 300, Chicago, IL 60604. Phone: (800) 952-4199 or (312) 939-3513. Note: Illinois also has Family Matters PTI serving 94 counties.

note: Illinois Part C is administered by the Department of Early Childhood (IDEC). Illinois has two PTI centers: Family Resource Center on Disabilities (serving Chicago area) and Family Matters (serving most of rest of state). For most of state outside Cook County area, Family Matters is the primary PTI.
